pairs.evidence: packages/domain/src/source.ts:93 The decision record's 'why' is optional for most sources and cannot be stored at all for suno, mv and trials (no reasons, no note). decision-records requires a reason on every rejection, so these rejects carry no telemetry for tuning what the producer is asked to make.

techniques.evidence: packages/domain/src/packet.machine.ts:22 The packet gate is an enumerated machine on the stored record. Committed and returned are terminal, so nothing can reopen a decided packet.

packages/domain/src/source.ts:93 Who (by), rev and at are recorded as an append-only log line, which is good. The rejection reason is optional (reasonOnReject is set only for seeds and spend) and impossible for suno, mv and trials.
packages/domain/src/board.ts:101 The Consequence token folds in both the decisions and the v1 digest. A commit is refused as stale-preview when either has moved.
packages/domain/src/board.ts:121 The consequence discloses deletes, writes, promotions and acts that leave the machine, computed before the commit.
packages/domain/src/board.ts:229 A listing of pending packets says when it was cut, so the rail's count is not a silent subset.

pairs.subject: hitl-approval
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/projects/runs/_runs/Runs.tsx:191 Retrying a failed or interrupted job sends only jobId and an optional raised ceiling, with no receipt and no token. A paid job's second attempt therefore spends again without a fresh disclosure bound to its parameters, while dojo start and re-route on the same screen do go through a receipt.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/projects/runs/_runs/Acts.tsx:13 The gate map calls retry spendless and reversible, but re-running a live vendor job spends again and cannot be undone. Consent is not bound to a parameter fingerprint at press time.
app/(studio)/projects/runs/_runs/dojo.ts:61 A dojo cycle starts only with a receipt token through the money-key action wrapper. The press is the operator's, not the machine's.
app/(studio)/projects/runs/_runs/Runs.tsx:170 A stale re-route confirm comes back as the fresh receipt instead of firing what was not shown.
app/(studio)/projects/runs/_runs/dojo.ts:28 The act is attributed to the authenticated operator's uid.
